blender_sources: Reproducible from the rig generator and retained Meshy GLBs; .blend files are not versioned.

mobile_asset_budget.rationale: Textured Meshy figures retain one reduced albedo atlas. Its encoded bytes are bounded separately from geometry, skin and twelve animation clips; the former total-size limit described untextured procedural figures.

android_performance: No device FPS claim is made by this package.
